description: Detailed monitoring for llama.cpp server with hybrid cache. Covers throughput, slot usage, hot/cold layers, checkpoint, branch tree, promotion latency, and diagnostics. Enable --metrics on the server.

spec.title: Exact Blob Restores by Result
spec.description: Exact blob restore attempts broken down by result and residency.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, result, residency) (rate(llamacpp:cache_exact_blob_restores_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Payload Transitions by Operation & Result
spec.description: Promotion and demotion decisions broken down by operation and result.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, operation, result) (rate(llamacpp:cache_payload_transitions_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Fallback Restores by Strategy
spec.description: Fallback restore decisions broken down by strategy, payload_kind, and result.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, strategy, result) (rate(llamacpp:cache_fallback_restores_by_shape_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Protected Root Decisions by Pressure Shape
spec.description: Protected-root admission decisions broken down by decision, pressure_source, and result.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, decision, pressure_source, result) (rate(llamacpp:cache_protected_root_decisions_by_shape_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Cache Hit Rate
spec.description: Fraction of lookups that result in a cache hit.

spec.expr: sum(rate(llamacpp:cache_hits_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval])) / clamp_min(sum(rate(llamacpp:cache_hits_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval])) + sum(rate(llamacpp:cache_misses_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval])), 1)

spec.title: Structured Diagnostics by Event
spec.description: Hybrid-cache structured diagnostic events broken down by event, result, and reason. Non-zero values indicate degraded or unsupported configurations.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, event, result, reason) (rate(llamacpp:cache_structured_diagnostics_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Prompt Evidence Records
spec.description: Prompt evidence record outcomes by mode and result.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, scope, result) (rate(llamacpp:cache_prompt_evidence_records_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Payload Evictions by Shape
spec.description: Payload eviction decisions broken down by payload_kind, pair_state, and result.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, payload_kind, pair_state, result) (rate(llamacpp:cache_payload_evictions_by_shape_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Cache Hits / Misses Rate
spec.description: Successful restores and lookup misses per second.

spec.title: Fallback & Restore Failure Rate
spec.description: Restores that fell back after descriptor or transaction failure, and total restore failures.

spec.title: Cache Entries
spec.description: Current hot cache entry count.

spec.title: Cache Resident Bytes
spec.description: Bytes currently held in the hot cache.

spec.title: Cached Token Count
spec.description: Total tokens currently resident in the hot cache.

spec.title: Evictions Rate
spec.description: Cache evictions per second (hot layer).

spec.title: Prompt Throughput
spec.description: Average prompt processing speed in tokens/s.

spec.title: Hot Payload Descriptors
spec.description: Payload descriptors currently in the hot (RAM) layer.

spec.title: Evicted Payload Descriptors
spec.description: Payload descriptors that have been evicted (metadata-only retention).

spec.title: Payload Eviction Rate
spec.description: Rate of hot payload evictions and decisions blocked by active slot refs.

spec.title: Protected Root Payload Bytes
spec.description: Bytes held by protected-root payloads in hot storage.

spec.title: Protected Root & Pairing Decisions
spec.description: Protected-root policy decisions and pairing violation rate.

spec.title: Payload Eviction Bytes
spec.description: Bytes evicted or demoted from hot storage per second.

spec.title: Generation Throughput
spec.description: Average token generation speed in tokens/s.

spec.title: Cold Storage: Used vs Budget
spec.description: Cold payload bytes currently on disk vs the configured cold budget.

spec.title: Cold Payload Count
spec.description: Number of cold payload descriptors currently on disk.

spec.title: Cold Bytes (Descriptor-Owned)
spec.description: Cold payload bytes tracked by active descriptors.

spec.title: Demotion & Promotion Rate
spec.description: Rate of hot-to-cold demotions and cold-to-hot promotions completed per second.

spec.title: Cold Evictions by Reason
spec.description: Rate of cold payload evictions broken down by reason and payload_kind.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, reason, payload_kind) (rate(llamacpp:cache_cold_evictions_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Demotion & Promotion Failures
spec.description: Rate of demotion and promotion operation failures by reason.

spec.title: Queue Full Events
spec.description: Rate of demotion and promotion queue-full events (backpressure indicator).

spec.title: Cold Cleanup & Orphan Removal
spec.description: Rate of cold file cleanup after eviction/pruning and orphan removal at startup.

spec.title: Requests Processing
spec.description: Number of requests currently being processed.

spec.title: Promotion Latency Distribution
spec.description: Stacked rate of promotions landing in each latency bucket. High buckets indicate I/O pressure.

spec.title: Promotion & Demotion Failure Reasons
spec.description: Breakdown of promotion and demotion failures by root cause.

spec.title: Requests Deferred
spec.description: Number of requests waiting for a free slot.

spec.title: Checkpoint Hit Rate
spec.description: Fraction of lookups accepted as checkpoint hits.

spec.title: Checkpoint Hits by Profile & Residency
spec.description: Accepted checkpoint cache hits broken down by profile and payload residency.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, profile, payload_residency) (rate(llamacpp:cache_checkpoint_hits_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Checkpoint Restores by Result
spec.description: Checkpoint restore attempts broken down by result.

spec.title: Checkpoint Admissions
spec.description: Rate of checkpoint payload admissions and failures.

spec.title: Checkpoint Admissions by Policy
spec.description: Checkpoint admissions under Stage 17 policy, broken down by policy, result, and reason.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, policy, result) (rate(llamacpp:cache_checkpoint_admissions_by_shape_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Busy Slots per Decode
spec.description: Average number of busy slots per llama_decode() call.

spec.title: Namespace Count
spec.description: Current number of active branch namespaces.

spec.title: Branch Nodes
spec.description: Total branch nodes across all namespaces.

spec.title: Branch Roots
spec.description: Total root nodes across all namespaces.

spec.title: Branch Metadata RAM Usage
spec.description: Current branch metadata RAM vs soft limit. Over limit triggers pruning.

spec.title: Namespace Metadata Bytes
spec.description: Total metadata bytes across all namespaces.

spec.title: Metadata Over Limit
spec.description: 1 = branch metadata currently exceeds soft limit.

spec.title: Metadata Ratio
spec.description: Branch metadata RAM ratio (used / soft limit).

spec.title: Branch Lookups by Method
spec.description: Rate of branch lookups using token_span and checksum_span methods.

spec.title: Branch Traversals by Operation
spec.description: Rate of branch tree traversals by operation type.

spec.title: Decode Call Rate
spec.description: Rate of llama_decode() calls per second.

spec.title: Branch Pruning & Metadata Admission Rejections
spec.description: Rate of branch metadata pruning and admission rejections due to metadata budget pressure.

spec.title: Node Rematerialization & Metadata Retention
spec.description: Rate of metadata-only node retentions after payload eviction, and re-materialization attempts.

spec.title: Forest Lock Acquires & Retries
spec.description: Rate of branch forest lock acquires and retries (spin contention indicator).

spec.title: Slot Reference Acquires & Releases
spec.description: Rate of slot reference acquires and releases. Imbalance suggests a ref leak.

spec.title: Peak Concurrent Slot Refs
spec.description: Highest concurrent slot reference count observed.

spec.title: Namespace Validation Results
spec.description: Rate of namespace validation checks and their pass/fail outcome.

spec.title: Token / Checksum Validation Mismatches
spec.description: Rate of token or checksum validation mismatches during restore lookup.

spec.title: Restore Misses by Reason
spec.description: Restore lookup misses broken down by reason, profile, and pair_state.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, reason, profile) (rate(llamacpp:cache_restore_misses_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

spec.title: Mismatch Parent Selections & Branch Dedup
spec.description: New-branch parent selections triggered by mismatches and equivalent-branch deduplications.

spec.title: Prefix Candidates by Result
spec.description: Prefix candidate evaluations broken down by result and reason.

spec.expr: sum by (mode, result, reason) (rate(llamacpp:cache_prefix_candidates_total{job="$job", instance=~"$instance", mode=~"$mode"}[$rate_interval]))

title: llama.cpp Server - Hybrid Cache
